description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Netherlands Netherlands official public holidays for 2026-2027; employee day-off status remains CAO/contract dependent result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when a public holiday is not automatically a paid day off for every Dutch employee. CAO, employment contract, sector, employer, school, bank and municipal schedules are not inferred; Liberation Day arrangements may be five-year/CAO dependent.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2027 authority events.
Example user requests: Netherlands: King's Day. | Netherlands: Ordinary weekday.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-04-27"} | {"date":"2026-04-28"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/netherlands-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/netherlands-public-working-day.md
name: check_nl_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Netherlands official public holidays for 2026-2027; employee day-off status remains CAO/contract dependent

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Official public-holiday dates are included; no universal employer closure is inferred because Dutch law leaves the day-off entitlement to the CAO or employment contract.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: No substitute-day closure is inferred; sector, CAO, employer and alternative-religious-holiday arrangements require separate evidence.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Netherlands Working Day
